headline: Fairly priced
summary: The $899k to $950k guide sits inside what similar houses nearby sold for, and matches Domain's $920k estimate. It has a bigger than usual house (300 m²) and lots of parking, which supports the upper half. With Melbourne prices easing (down 3.9% over three months), aim for the lower end of the guide.
notes: No previous sale on record for this address, so there's no 'up or down since last sale' figure.
